title.episodeTitle: What Is Still There When I'm Eighty?

music.note: Current ESSY series default, explicitly selected for this episode. Source and mix convention derived from completed ESSY-0001/0002/0003/0004 final-assembly metadata. Gain applies at mix time only. Opening insertion comes from the shared delivery plan, not this file.

bgmTargetDurationRationale: Delivery duration = approved content assembly timeline 380.664s + openingIdentity insertion 4.000s (shared delivery plan, production-package.openingIdentity) + ending hold 4.000s. The BGM extended master must cover the full DELIVERY timeline, not narration-master + hold (380.664 + 4.0), because the opening insertion is body time, not pre-roll: it carries no pre-roll offset in the mix, so the BGM starts at delivery t=0 exactly as the narration does. build-bgm-extended.mjs is therefore invoked with an explicit --target; its default (narration master + hold) would be 4s short and fail the final renderer's coverage check.
